name: Healthy and Delicious: Southern-Style Black-Eyed Peas with Bacon

instructions.primary_message: The day before you plan to serve this dish, put the peas in a bowl, cover with water by at least 5 cm, and refrigerate. The next day, drain well before using.
Center a rack in the oven and preheat the oven to 135°C (275°F).
Place the bacon in a small cast-iron pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and cook until it renders its fat, about 6 or 7 minutes.

Add the onions, garlic, oregano (or Italian seasoning), and black pepper and cook, stirring, for 8 minutes. Add the drained peas, bay leaves, salt, and 6 cups water. Bring to a simmer, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise until the peas are tender, at least 1 hour 15 minutes. Stir in the Tabasco, sprinkle with the parsley, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: black eyed peas, Daniel Boulud, healthy and delicious, inexpensive

description: Daniel Boulud's Southern-Style Black-Eyed Peas with Bacon is perfectly spicy with a deep (but not overwhelming) bacon flavor. After a first few bites, my boyfriend and I couldn’t get enough.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 13 hr 40 min to 1 day 1 hr 40 min.

Optional or for serving: Fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves, for garnish

Optional substitutions: dried oregano → Italian seasoning; coarse sea salt → kosher salt; sauce → hot sauce
author: Kristen Swensson Sturt
